entities.summary: Mark Gonzales, also known as "Gonz", "The Gonz", and "The Godfather", is an American professional skateboarder and artist. A pioneer in the development of modern street skating, he is considered one of the first street-style skateboarders alongside Natas Kaupas. Gonzales and Kaupas are also credited with the first known boardslides on a handrail. Gonzales' pioneering influence on skateboarding has caused him to be known as the "God Father" of modern street skateboarding, and he was named the "Most Influential Skateboarder of All Time" by Transworld Skateboarding magazine in December 2011, where Gonzales was placed ahead of Tony Hawk (2nd) and Rodney Mullen (3rd).

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Mark Gonzales' pioneering influence on modern street skateboarding led to a paradigm shift in the sport, inspiring generations of skaters and shaping the trajectory of action sports. His recognition as 'Most Influential Skateboarder of All Time' by Transworld Skateboarding magazine underscores his lasting impact.
